nodes.label: Dev-only db service (casinos-db-dev)
nodes.rationale: Only the database in Docker so the backend can run with npm run dev without rebuilding containers; do not run with root compose simultaneously.

nodes.label: back service (casinos-back, port 5000)
nodes.rationale: Bind mounts data/ and reports/ so Excel files can be dropped from Windows Explorer without entering the container.

nodes.label: Customer OTP auth (/customers/otp)
nodes.rationale: Accepts both 'otp' and 'code' fields for compatibility.

nodes.label: Sequelize models (Business, Product, Order, Customer, Inventory...)
nodes.norm_label: sequelize models (business, product, order, customer, inventory...)

nodes.label: Excel importer (npm run import)
nodes.rationale: Idempotent: each row keyed by file + sheet + row number so re-imports update rather than duplicate.

nodes.label: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL (baked at build)
nodes.rationale: Variable is baked into the Next.js build, so the front must be rebuilt when it changes.

nodes.label: Operfoodss Admin (SaaS fast-food panel)
nodes.rationale: Base project with mock UI; real auth, global state and persistence pending.

nodes.label: casinos-front admin panel (Next.js 16)
nodes.rationale: Pure UI: no database or business logic of its own; consumes casinos-back API.

nodes.label: casinos-back (API + Excel importer)
nodes.rationale: Generic schema: each Excel sales sheet defines its own casino 'unidad', so new casinos are added by re-importing without code changes.

nodes.label: Casinos Sales & Customer Admin System
nodes.rationale: Designed to start locally on the client PC and be moved as-is to a server when casinos need real-time sales registration.

nodes.label: Controller -> Service -> Repository pattern
nodes.rationale: Modular architecture by domain; each module owns its layered business logic.

nodes.label: Next.js agent rules (breaking-changes warning)
nodes.rationale: Next.js version differs from training data; agents must read node_modules/next/dist/docs before coding.

nodes.label: Local-to-server migration path
nodes.rationale: Same docker-compose is deployed to a server; only .env (NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, DB creds) changes, plus building per-casino role login. Data model, API and Power BI views stay unchanged.
